name: LongCat-Video
one_liner: An AI model that generates video straight from a text description or a single image, no camera or footage needed.
buyer: A YouTuber or marketing agency who needs a short explainer or product video fast and can't afford a film crew.
business_use_cases: A news-explainer YouTuber generates illustrative b-roll for a breaking story that has no real footage.
A marketing agency generates dozens of short product-demo video variants for ad testing without reshoots.
An e-commerce seller turns a single product photo into a short promotional video clip for social ads.

money_ideas.idea: Wrap the model behind a simple web app and charge per video generated.
Sell a monthly plan to small marketing agencies for a bundle of generated ad videos.
Offer a one-off custom video-ad service to local businesses who send a product photo and get a video back.

steal_this: This weekend, build a one-page tool: upload a product photo, get a 10-second promo video back, and sell packs of 10 videos to local shop owners.
